name: IxSHE Tell
source:
Hajime is the school students' representative and the student council president, thanks to whom the rule banning romantic relationships in school was lifted. Although he's now a hero who allowed everyone freedom to love, he now has no time to enjoy it himself! If any problem arises, the whole success will be for naught and the rule might be brought back... 

At such time, he is confessed to by Kasumi, a transfer student who is also his childhood friend. Furthermore, on the next day he was confessed to by the sister school's charismatic student council president Yui, and by the school idol who won miss contest twice in a row - Ayaka!

However, one of the few students who is against romance, the  "anti-romance faction" leader, and the vice president of the student council, Yoshino has declared "Come on, let's enter a relationship and cause problems and bring back the ban on romance!".

Hajime was happy to be loved by so many people, but decided that first he should get to know everyone better.

As if waiting for him to say it, his other childhood friend Shiori, a perfect yamato nadeshiko, has confessed to him while saying she knows him best of all.

Right after the ban on love has been lifted, the protagonist finds himself incredibly popular with several girls approaching him aggressively and from all directions. His love story begins abruptly...
translation:
阿一是学校的学生代表兼学生会主席，多亏了他，学校里禁止恋爱的规定才得以解除。虽然他现在是一个让所有人都可以自由恋爱的英雄，但是他现在却没有时间自己去享受！一旦出了什么问题，一切的成功都将化为泡影，规则可能会被恢复…… 

这时，他的青梅竹马转学生霞向他表白了。而且第二天，他就被姊妹校的魅力十足的学生会会长结衣，以及连续两次获得小姐大赛冠军的学园偶像——绫香告白了！

然而，少数反对恋爱的学生之一、“反恋爱派”领袖、学生会副会长吉野却宣称“来吧，让我们谈恋爱，制造问题，恢复恋爱禁令！”。

始很高兴受到这么多人的喜爱，但他决定首先应该更好地了解每个人。

仿佛在等待他说出这句话，他的另一个青梅竹马诗织，一个完美的大和抚子，向他告白，并说她是最了解他的人。

爱情禁令解除后，主角发现自己非常受欢迎，有几个女孩从四面八方主动接近他。他的爱情故事就这样突然开始了……
